# Scenario Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System — URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the scenario requirements (domains 12 Greenfield, 13 Brownfield, 14 Ambiguous requirement; plus the reliability drills)
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md §Required Scenarios](../spec.md) · [plan.md §11](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Tags**: `[Mandatory]` / `[Enhancement]`; `Detects:` names the guide failure trap an item guards against.

## Greenfield Scenario (SCN-A)

- [ ] CHK001 Is the SCN-A input fixed verbatim with numbered acceptance criteria? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-A] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the evidence required to show why clarification is not needed, so that no artificial clarification gate is inserted? [Clarity, Spec §SCN-A, §FR-ORC-13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the API and schema impacts of SCN-A specified (fields, error codes, migration, contract version)? [Completeness, Plan §2 change impact records, contracts/CHANGELOG.md 1.1.0] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the SCN-A orchestration path specified with its parallel and join points? [Completeness, Plan §11] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the escalation path defined for ambiguity that emerges later in SCN-A (affected path only)? [Coverage, Spec §SCN-A, §FR-RPL-06] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is each SCN-A evidence item (E-A1..E-A9) tied to the command that regenerates it? [Traceability, Spec §SC-009] [Mandatory]

## Brownfield Scenario (SCN-B)

- [ ] CHK007 Does SCN-B require impact analysis before any design or code change, covering components, interfaces, data flows, tests, docs, regression risks, and rollout/rollback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-14, §SCN-B] Detects: material change implemented without impact analysis. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it specified that the impact analysis is derived from the current codebase, and what happens if the codebase is unavailable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-14, ADR-017, research R-14] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are regression expectations for existing links and consumers stated measurably? [Measurability, Spec §SCN-B AC-4 and constraints] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the data-compatibility and rollback story specified (additive migration, NULL semantics, stored limits after withdrawal)? [Completeness, data-model.md V4, Clarifications Q4, ADR-010] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the conflict between the existing fail-open analytics rule and the new fail-closed behavior identified as an impacted requirement? [Consistency, Plan §11 SCN-B, Spec §FR-ANL-04] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the repository-level brownfield gate (impact analysis before the click-limit code is written) sequenced in the delivery plan? [Traceability, Plan §14 M7] [Mandatory]

## Ambiguous Requirement Scenario (SCN-C)

- [ ] CHK013 Is each expected ambiguity in AMB-001 classified with type and severity? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-C, Plan §11] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it specified that no downstream stage starts while clarification is pending, and how that is evidenced? [Clarity, Spec §US6 scenarios 1–2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the rule "do not auto-approve clarification and do not fabricate human decisions" reflected in how scenario evidence is produced (simulated input labeled)? [Consistency, Spec §SCN-C reference decisions, Constitution X] Detects: fabricated results. [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified how clarification answers become an updated requirement (new version, derived acceptance criteria, exclusions)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-08, Plan §11] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the expected replanning outcome specified (plan version diff listing the added stages)? [Measurability, Plan §11 SCN-C] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the bound on clarification rounds and the resulting outcome specified? [Edge Case, PVT-14, Spec §FR-REL-06] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the three scenarios specified to differ materially (classification, stage sets, gates, and capabilities)? [Consistency, Spec §Required Scenarios] [Mandatory]

## Reliability Drills

- [ ] CHK020 Is each reliability control (retry, fallback, compensation, deadline, resume, policy exception, operator controls) covered by a drill with an expected outcome? [Coverage, Spec §RDR table] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the drill expectations consistent with the policy set (for example, the fallback drill versus policy CHG-002)? [Consistency, quickstart.md §6, Plan §9, docs/adr/README.md §4] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Review owner: the human candidate (Gates G2/G5)
